not_met.question: Q3
not_met.lacks: A developer meeting a choice in making a deliverable that no line names, such as the exact form in which tidy --dry-run prints a move, can't tell from any principle's why whether the generator settles it as one of its own small points or names it open for the main conversation. The generator's small points appear only in Components, at rn/architecture.md:306, 'each small point of making it, such as a phrase', with no why. The whys of Good from the root, at rn/architecture.md:158, 'a fix laid on the deliverable beside the design is a part that no decision holds', and of A point found open, at rn/architecture.md:193, 'a choice between ways that serve them alike', argue that any choice no decision holds goes back. So the developer of the generator's part and the developers of the evaluator's and the main conversation's parts can draw the line in different places, and the parts then disagree on which choices reach the user and which land in the report of decisions taken without asking.
